summary: Backend and data work with data-science and backend teams: extraction and ingestion pipelines, ETL and the Linux and AWS infrastructure that runs them.
achievements: Migrated an ingestion pipeline for external data sources from Python to Go and scaled it to four Docker containers: from about 8k clean records in 2 hours on one instance to nearly 200k in 6 hours.

Optimized an internal ETL that took 2 to 4 hours and peaked above 60 GB of RAM, crashing its ECS Fargate task: it now finishes in at most 1 hour, peaks at 36–40 GB according to the logs, and the out-of-memory failure has not happened again.
Build and operate Python and TypeScript services backed by SQL, on Linux servers and AWS.
